_comment: Pinned engines and worker scripts (plan section 3, A1 section A7). Recorded 2026-10-15 from the user-folder extract under LOCALAPPDATA/URI/engines/libreoffice-26.8.1. Provenance: the downloaded MSI (winget cache) SHA-256 c6298b10...5312 equals the winget manifest; the extract was made with msiexec /a (no elevation); soffice.bin equals the qualified pin and is Authenticode-signed by The Document Foundation (status Valid on 2026-10-15). The MSI kept in the folder is the administrative-image copy written by msiexec /a (19,836,928 bytes) and is excluded from the manifest. Update workers with: python -m uri_office.engines pin-workers Correction 2026-10-15: the first pin (root 70a9c1e1..., 19,457 files) included 40 Python bytecode files (__pycache__) that LibreOffice's embedded Python wrote during the day-1 spikes; the MSI ships no .pyc. All __pycache__ folders were removed and the pin re-recorded (19,417 files). The engine now runs with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and the bridge with -B, and any added file fails the integrity check.
